note: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out partway through this part, so the later candidates were looked for only on government sites that answered and on campaign addresses that were tried and then read in full (a site counts only when it names the candidate and the office or place). No Arkansas party page calls anything an endorsement for these races (see ballot/lean/ar_endorsements.json), so no endorsed_by is recorded; the Washington County Democrats' candidate list names Diane Bryant, Beth Coger and Mark Farrer, but it is a list, not an endorsement. Richard Womack's site (richardwomack.com) still shows the 2022 'Republican Primary May 24th' and names no 2026 office, so it is not recorded. Max Deitchler was 40 in May 2025 by Talk Business & Politics, which leaves 1984 or 1985, so no birth year. A 5NEWS report that the Democratic Party of Washington County named Deitchler to the Election Commission refused this machine (403), so no past_party is recorded from it. Jeremy Riddle (HD 42) is reported by directories to have served on the Greenbrier school board, but no page read tied that board member to the 2026 House race, so nothing is recorded. Evelyn Moorehead's site lists 'Special Judge, Pulaski County Circuit Court' without years; left out as unsure. Nothing was found for Mark Farrer, Diane Bryant, Wendy Howerton, Andrew Brink, Benny Johnson, Nara Smith, Mark Brannan or Isbac Ceja, nor a campaign site for Joey Carr, Zack Gramlich, Jeremiah Moore or David Ray.
